indicators: Release assets of five existing GitHub releases replaced; source, tags and CI unchanged
Malicious build reports `ovhcloud version` as undefined with commit 5ead8ef
summary: Binaries attached to five existing GitHub releases of the OVHcloud CLI (v0.11.0 to v0.15.0) were swapped for a credential stealer for about 94 minutes on 2026-10-19; source code and tags were untouched, so no registry advisory exists.
remediation: If an ovhcloud binary was downloaded from GitHub releases between 12:47 and 14:21 UTC on 2026-10-19, treat the host as compromised: rotate every secret it could read from another machine, delete the binary and /tmp/envchecker-*, reinstall v0.16.0 and verify it with gh release verify-asset. Audit CI jobs that fetched those assets in the window.

sources.title: OVHcloud CLI Compromised via GitHub Release Swap: Detonating the Real GlassWorm Loader and What We Found

review.notes: Approved by the PO on 2026-10-27. Not a package-registry incident, so OSV will never carry it; this record exists for that reason. Homebrew, go install and Docker were not exposed.
